about.title: The Rider's Story
about.subtitle: Meet Alex Vance
about.bio_p1: I started Moto Vlogz in 2018 with a simple goal: to document the parts of the world that highways bypass. For me, motorcycling isn't just about speed; it's about vulnerability, connection, and the raw grit of the trail. I travel solo with a heavy adventure bike, two action cameras, and a drone.
about.bio_p2: From crossing the desert dunes of South America to negotiating the technical, high-altitude muddy trails of the Himalayas, my channel is a front-row seat to the joys and struggles of extreme touring. No crew, no scripts, just pure adventure.
about.card_bike_desc: BMW R1250GS Adventure equipped with heavy-duty crash bars, knobby tires, and aluminum luggage.
about.card_miles_desc: Over 180,000 miles ridden across 5 continents, including paved highways and rugged forest trails.
about.card_trip_desc: Completed a solo, unsupported crossing of the Trans-Siberian Highway through remote wilderness.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions about the setups, editing, or routes? Start here.
faq.q1: What cameras do you use to film your rides?
faq.a1: I film primarily using two DJI Action 4 cameras (one on the helmet chin, one handlebar-mounted), a Sony a7S III for cinematic off-bike shots, and a DJI Mavic 3 Pro drone for landscape aerials.
faq.q2: How do you navigate in remote areas?
faq.a2: I use a Garmin Zumo XT motorcycle GPS loaded with OSM maps, supplemented by GPX tracks on the Gaia GPS app on a ruggedized Android phone as a backup.
faq.q3: Do you travel alone? Is it safe?
faq.a3: 90% of my trips are solo. While there are risks, thorough planning, a reliable satellite communicator (Garmin InReach), and general caution make solo adventure riding highly rewarding.
faq.q4: Which bike is best for adventure touring?
faq.a4: The best bike is the one you already own. While I ride a BMW 1250GS for heavy luggage capacity and highway speed, lighter bikes like a Tenere 700 or a CRF300L are much easier to handle in mud and sand.
